name: Pristine Euro Top
description: Consists of a Pocketed Spring base with a 3” Euro Top with layers of Comfort Foam and Natural Latex Foam finished with Quilted Cashmere / Medicott Fabric. The perforated top Natural Latex Layer induces air flow keeping the surface ventilated with medium-firm support.
whyMatchExplain: The Pristine Euro Top balances zero-partner-disturbance pocket springs with a buoyant 3” Euro top containing natural latex and rubberised coir. It cradles thoracic pressure while preventing lower spine sagging.
bestFor: Side and back sleepers wanting plush contouring with zero partner motion transfer.

name: Heavenly Luxury
description: An ultimately luxurious Spring Mattress which fully relaxes your body. Consisting of a Pocketed Spring Unit topped with multiple layers of Comfort Foam, Perforated Latex and contour-adjusting Memory Foam wrapped in premium Jacquard fabric.
whyMatchExplain: Designed for sleepers requiring deep pressure relief at the shoulder blades and pelvic joints. The memory foam adjusts to body contours while perforated latex prevents heat buildup.
bestFor: Side sleepers and individuals with sensitive pressure points at hips and shoulders.
tradeOffNote: Plush contour hug; stomach sleepers requiring rigid resistance may prefer Coir.

name: Supreme Bliss
description: A supreme mattress of uncompromising quality featuring Pocketed Spring technology with a top layer of Natural Latex Foam. The perforated latex absorbs body heat and induces air circulation, elegantly finished with quilted bamboo fabric.
whyMatchExplain: Combines organic bamboo thermoregulation with responsive natural latex bounce and zero-disturbance pocket springs, delivering balanced orthopedic ergonomics for mixed postures.
bestFor: Mixed position sleepers seeking responsive bounce with organic temperature control.
tradeOffNote: Offers active spring resilience rather than slow-sinking memory foam.

name: Blossom Spring
description: For a quality Spring Mattress at an affordable price. Built with a heavy-duty Bonnell Spring unit sandwiched between 2 layers of Comfort Foam and Rubberised Coir, aiding in maintaining posture by evenly distributing body weight.
whyMatchExplain: The Bonnell Spring network acts as an active resilient trampoline that distributes body mass evenly across the entire surface while coir pads prevent spring indentation.
bestFor: Solo sleepers and guest rooms seeking dependable whole-body spring push-back.
tradeOffNote: Interconnected coils transfer minor kinetic movement between bed partners.

name: Royal Classic Coir
description: A Rubberised Coir mattress with the feel and comfort of a Spring Mattress. Consists of a Comfort Foam layer sandwiched between 2 firm, springy blocks of Rubberised Coir topped with perforated Natural Latex Foam and Quilted Knitted Fabric.
whyMatchExplain: The sandwiched coir-and-foam engineering replicates spring bounce using 100% eco-friendly natural coir and latex, providing dynamic spine push-back with zero chemical off-gassing.
bestFor: Eco-conscious back sleepers wanting firm spine alignment with breathable airflow.
tradeOffNote: Firmer natural feel; side sleepers needing deep shoulder sinking should choose Latex/Spring.

name: Orthopaedic Coir
description: Manufactured with a high-density Rubberised Coir block, providing an extra firm surface engineered for lumbar and neck support. Finished with 100% Raw Cotton Fabric for maximum breathability to provide natural relief from back and neck aches.
materials: High Density Natural Rubberised Coir Block
whyMatchExplain: Your posture highlights spine deviation or lumbar sinkage. The high-density coir block keeps the spine strictly straight on the horizontal axis, eliminating sacral curvature strain during sleep.
bestFor: Individuals with lower back pain or lumbar instability requiring strict planar spine support.
tradeOffNote: Clinical extra-firm rigidity with minimal plush give; not suited for soft mattress preferences.

name: Orthopaedic Classic
description: A firm sleeping surface with added surface comfort. This all-natural high density Rubberised Coir mattress is topped with a layer of Perforated Natural Latex Foam and encased in 100% Raw Cotton fabric to ease back and neck aches.
layers: 2. Natural Latex Foam Layer (Perforated Air Flow)
whyMatchExplain: Blends therapeutic rigid coir support with a gentle top layer of natural latex. Keeps the spine in pristine anatomical alignment while softening pressure against the ribcage and pelvic bones.
bestFor: Back and stomach sleepers needing firm orthopedic posture correction with gentle surface relief.
tradeOffNote: Firm supportive base; prioritize spinal straightness over deep contour sink.

name: Comfy Gel Foam
description: Incorporating revolutionary gel infusion technology with a firm base comprising high-density foams and a Visco Elastic foam layer that adjusts to body contours. Infused gel particles absorb heat for cool, uninterrupted sleep.
layers: 2. Gel Infused Visco Elastic Foam Layer
whyMatchExplain: The microscopic gel beads actively absorb body heat while the visco-elastic foam eliminates pressure spikes on the shoulders and trochanter, ideal for warm climates and side sleepers.
bestFor: Side sleepers and hot sleepers needing joint pressure contouring with heat-dissipating gel.
tradeOffNote: Conforming memory foam feel; users preferring high spring bounce may prefer Supreme Bliss.

name: Zee Foam
description: Uniquely designed with an extra thick comfort foam layer supported by an extra thick re-bonded foam base. The quilted fabric with extra padding maximizes durability, comfort, and posture support.
whyMatchExplain: High-density rebonded foam foundation provides non-sagging structural rigidity, while the top comfort foam padding shields the musculoskeletal frame against firm pressure points.
bestFor: Daily durable support for medium to heavy weight frames needing sag-free stability.
tradeOffNote: Denser core construction; offers solid stability with medium cushioning depth.

name: Plus Max Convoluted
description: Triple Layer Mattress consisting of an engineered Convoluted Foam Layer, a Comfort Foam Layer supported by a Rebonded Foam Layer. Convoluted foam minimizes excessive sweating by maximizing temperature control and continuous airflow.
whyMatchExplain: The sculpted peak-and-valley convoluted foam channels trapped body heat away from the skin surface while providing distributed point-elastic support.
bestFor: Warm sleepers and lighter frames desiring continuous convective ventilation channels.
tradeOffNote: 5-inch compact thickness; heavyweight sleepers may prefer 8+ inch mattresses.
